correctness.rationale: Direct integration of cardinal quadratic pieces gives the symmetric five-diagonal Toeplitz Gram with strictly positive symbol (c^2+13c+16)/30≥2/15. Contour residues of reciprocal quartic yield the exact inverse coefficients A r^{|k|}+C s^{|k|}. Finite support then gives an exact two-exponential kernel on every remote right cell. A quadratic F_r has exactly one zero in (0,1), the F_s factor at that point is nonzero, and the cell suprema of Φ_r,Φ_s give the claimed sharp decay bases. A standalone checker verifies 297 representative identities without substituting numerics for the proof.

value.rationale: Precise local kernel decay underpins spline projection localization, dual basis truncation and accurate pointwise evaluation. This theorem identifies a unique geometry-dependent evaluation site where the dominant exponential Gram mode cancels exactly, yielding a ~10-fold smaller geometric decay base on the entire remote half-line, and proves the effect is necessarily one-sided. It distinguishes local sharp rate behavior not captured by uniform estimates; it is not an arbitrary table recomputation or a general textbook bound.
